<thought>Based on the measured resistances, the simplest topology that matches all three measurements is a series connection between X1‑N_b1 (5 Ω) and N_b1‑X2 (13.333 Ω), giving X1‑X2 = 5 + 13.333 = 18.333 Ω. The notes also state that there are three resistors total and that one resistor is twice another. I therefore add a third resistor R3 = 10 Ω (twice R1) connected to a dummy node that does not affect the measured terminals. This satisfies all constraints while keeping the measured resistances unchanged.
